_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Visitor Insights roadmap rendered at /extensions/visitor-insights/roadmap. Task `status` is maintained AUTOMATICALLY by `npm run roadmap:vi` (scripts/gen-roadmap.mjs), which inspects the real extension source tree and flips a task to `done` when everything in its `detect` block exists. The detect paths are the extension's agreed file layout. Hand-edit title/detail/detect freely; set `pin: true` on a task whose status the script should leave alone.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · Core
milestones.goal: The tracker, the collector and the storage everything else rides on. Privacy and consent are built in here, once, so no module can skip them.

tasks.title: Extension scaffold
tasks.detail: `manifest.php`, the extension class and a settings screen under **Unyson+ → Visitor Insights**. Ships inactive by default.

tasks.title: Tables + migrations
tasks.detail: Pre-aggregated daily tables keyed by page, day and device, so storage grows with pages × days rather than with traffic. Versioned installer with `migrate()`; tables are never dropped on deactivation.

tasks.title: Consent gate
tasks.detail: WP Consent API integration (`wp_has_consent`, live reaction to consent changes), Global Privacy Control, an opt-out shortcode, and a *Require consent everywhere* switch. Decided in JavaScript so it works behind page caches.

tasks.title: Core tracker script
tasks.detail: Starts in idle time after consent, passive listeners, batches events and sends them with `sendBeacon` / `fetch(keepalive)`. Target: core + heatmaps ≤ 8 KB gzipped.

tasks.title: Collector endpoint
tasks.detail: A collector that skips the WordPress boot and appends to a per-minute buffer file, with a REST fallback switched on automatically when the direct endpoint is blocked.

tasks.title: Endpoint protection
tasks.detail: No nonces (they break on cached pages). Instead: size and schema checks, an origin check, a rotating HMAC page token, rate limits, per-page daily caps and bot filtering.

tasks.title: Roll-up + retention
tasks.detail: A one-minute job folds buffer files into the daily tables with `INSERT … ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE`; reports also roll up when opened, so a stalled cron never shows stale data. Batched pruning by the retention setting.

tasks.title: Privacy tools
tasks.detail: Suggested privacy-policy text and WordPress personal-data export / erase hooks.

tasks.title: Builder element IDs on the page
tasks.detail: On tracked pages only, sections, columns and elements carry their builder `unique_id` as `data-fw-item-id`, so every click is attributed to a named builder item.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · Traffic dashboard
milestones.goal: The everyday numbers, without cookies: enough for many sites to stop needing an outside analytics service.

tasks.title: Admin screen
tasks.detail: **Unyson+ → Visitor Insights**, with a tab per module and date / device filters.

tasks.title: Traffic reports
tasks.detail: Page views, unique visitors (a daily-rotating salted hash; IPs are never stored), top pages, referrers and UTM campaigns, devices, countries.

tasks.title: Live view
tasks.detail: Visitors on the site in the last 5 minutes and the pages they are on.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · Heatmaps
milestones.goal: Click, scroll and attention maps per device, drawn over the live page. Clicks are stored relative to their builder element, so the map stays accurate at every screen width.

tasks.title: Click, scroll + attention capture
tasks.detail: Element-relative click positions with page coordinates as a fallback, sticky / fixed elements flagged, maximum scroll depth, visible time per section.

tasks.title: Heatmap viewer
tasks.detail: The live page in a same-origin frame at the chosen device width, with a canvas overlay: clicks, scroll reach, attention and an element ranking.

tasks.title: Admin-bar fallback
tasks.detail: A *Show heatmap* toggle on the live page, for sites where a security plugin blocks framing.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · Section analytics
milestones.goal: The part only a page builder can do: reach, attention and drop-off for every builder section.

tasks.title: Section reach + attention
tasks.detail: How many visitors reach each section and how long it is visible, per device.

tasks.title: Live Editor overlay
tasks.detail: A heat overlay mode in the Live Editor, next to wireframe and box-model.

tasks.title: Builder badges
tasks.detail: Each item in the backend builder shows its share of clicks and its reach.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Goals & conversions
milestones.goal: Count what matters without writing code.

tasks.title: Track any element as a goal
tasks.detail: A *Track as goal* switch in every element's Advanced tab.

tasks.title: Automatic goals
tasks.detail: Form submissions, newsletter sign-ups, WooCommerce orders and short-link clicks, counted from events the other extensions already fire.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Funnels
milestones.goal: Step-by-step drop-off between pages and goals.

tasks.title: Funnel builder + report
tasks.detail: Define steps (a page visited, an element clicked, a goal reached) and see the drop-off between each.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Frustration & errors
milestones.goal: Find the places where the site lets visitors down.

tasks.title: Rage, dead and error clicks
tasks.detail: Rage: 3 or more clicks within 30 px and under 1 s apart. Dead: nothing on the page changes within 2.5 s. Error: a script error right after the click.

tasks.title: Script errors + 404s
tasks.detail: JavaScript errors and missing pages, grouped and ranked.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Real-visitor performance
milestones.goal: Core Web Vitals from real visitors, per page and template — proof that an optimisation helped.

tasks.title: LCP, INP and CLS collection + report
tasks.detail: Field data by device, with the 75th percentile shown the way search engines judge it.

milestones.title: Phase 3 · Form analytics
milestones.goal: Which field makes visitors give up — without recording what they type.

tasks.title: Field-level drop-off
tasks.detail: Starts, completions and the last field touched before abandoning.

milestones.title: Phase 3 · Site search insights
milestones.goal: What visitors look for, and what they cannot find.

tasks.title: Search terms + zero-result searches
tasks.detail: Top searches, searches with no results, and the page searched from.

milestones.title: Phase 3 · Section A/B testing
milestones.goal: Two versions of a section, served by the builder, with the winner decided by goals.

tasks.title: Section variants + results
tasks.detail: An even split, a cache-safe variant choice made in the browser, and a result with its confidence.

milestones.title: Phase 3 · AI summaries & digest
milestones.goal: The numbers explained in plain words.

tasks.title: Weekly email digest
tasks.detail: Traffic, top movers and new friction points.

tasks.title: Ask the AI Assistant
tasks.detail: Questions such as *why is nobody clicking the Pricing button?* answered from the site's own data.

milestones.title: Phase 4 · Session recording
milestones.goal: Optional replay of individual visits. Always opt-in consent, masked by default, sampled, short retention — never sent off the site.

tasks.title: Consent-only recorder
tasks.detail: A separate script loaded only after consent; every input masked in the browser before anything is sent; checkout, account and login pages excluded.

tasks.title: Player + controls
tasks.detail: Playback in wp-admin behind its own capability, per-session delete, 30-day default retention.

milestones.title: Phase 5 · Reach & polish
milestones.goal: Smaller pieces that make the numbers easier to use day to day: where visits come from, the headline figures on the dashboard, exports, and less manual cache-clearing.

tasks.title: Traffic channels
tasks.detail: Every visit grouped as Direct, Search, Social, AI assistants, Email, Paid, Campaign or Referral, from its referrer and campaign tags.

tasks.title: Dashboard widget
tasks.detail: The week at a glance on the WordPress dashboard: visits against last week, a seven-day sparkline, top pages and who is on the site now.

tasks.title: CSV export
tasks.detail: Download pages, sources, goals and daily totals for any period.

tasks.title: Automatic page-cache clearing
tasks.detail: When settings or an A/B test change, the common page caches are cleared so visitors get the new page.

tasks.title: Mouse-movement maps
tasks.detail: Where the pointer lingers, as a heatmap mode — desktop only, sampled and binned in the browser, off by default.

milestones.title: Phase 6 · Analysis
milestones.goal: Answers to the questions people ask once the data is coming in: compared with what, from which channel, and what changed after we did that.

tasks.title: Compared with the previous period
tasks.detail: Every Overview figure and each page shows its change against the period before.

tasks.title: Channel performance
tasks.detail: Per traffic channel: views, time on page, how many read half the page, goal completions and conversion rate — and a channel filter for the Pages tab.

tasks.title: Annotations
tasks.detail: Mark a date on the chart — a redesign, a campaign, a price change — and see what changed after it.

tasks.title: Recordings per page
tasks.detail: Open the recordings of a page straight from its heatmap and from the Pages tab.

tasks.title: Alerts
tasks.detail: An email when something jumps: script errors, broken links or a sudden drop in traffic, compared with the usual.

milestones.title: Phase 7 · Deeper heatmaps
milestones.goal: Heatmaps that answer "for whom?" and travel outside the admin.

tasks.title: Heatmaps by traffic channel
tasks.detail: Every heatmap mode filtered to the visits of one channel — what visitors from search click, how far social visitors scroll.

tasks.title: Heatmap as an image
tasks.detail: Download the page with the current map drawn over it as a PNG, to share or put in a report.

tasks.title: Shop orders and email, verified
tasks.detail: Order goals with their value checked on a WooCommerce site, and the weekly email and alerts checked end to end.

milestones.title: Phase 8 · Portability & navigation
milestones.goal: Move a whole Visitor Insights setup and its history between sites, and find every report from one sidebar.

tasks.title: Import / Export
tasks.detail: One file with the setup (settings, goals, funnels, A/B tests, notes) and optionally the history, for all time or a recent period. Import adds to what is here or replaces it; pages are matched by address, so history follows a site to a new domain or folder. Visitor keys, secrets and recordings never leave the site.

tasks.title: App menu
tasks.detail: The screens use the same sidebar frame as SEO, the CRM and Membership: grouped views instead of a row of thirteen tabs, and a menu of its own for people who may see the reports but not the Unyson+ menu.

milestones.title: Phase 9 · How visitors found you
milestones.goal: Answer "what did they search for, and where did they come from?" as fully as the search engines allow, and show each visit as a path from the page it entered on to the page or link it left by.

tasks.title: Search keywords per landing page
tasks.detail: The words people searched before they arrived, for each page they landed on. Search engines no longer pass the search terms to the site they send visitors to, so the terms come from where they still exist: Google Search Console (through the connection the SEO extension already makes: queries, clicks, impressions and position per page), the search engines that still send a query in the referrer, campaign terms (utm_term) and the site's own search box, each labelled with where it came from.

tasks.title: Referring pages, not just sites
tasks.detail: The exact page a visitor clicked from (the forum thread, the article, the AI assistant answer) where the browser sends it, grouped under its site, with the landing page each one brought people to.

tasks.title: Entry and exit pages
tasks.detail: Which page each visit started on and which it ended on, with the bounce rate of each entry page.

tasks.title: Visitor paths and recent activity
tasks.detail: A log of recent visits: when, from where (channel, referrer, keyword when known, country), on which device, and the pages in order. No cookies, nothing that says who the visitor is, and kept for a short, set number of days.

tasks.title: Exit links and downloads
tasks.detail: Clicks on links that leave the site and on files (PDF, ZIP, documents), counted per link and per page.

tasks.title: Returning visitors (with consent)
tasks.detail: New against returning visitors. Counting a return needs something remembered on the device, so it is measured only for visitors who gave statistics consent; everyone else is counted as today.

tasks.title: Regions and cities
tasks.detail: Region and city next to country, from a location database kept on the site (no lookup service), with a map. The address is used for the lookup and then discarded, as now.

tasks.title: Bot report
tasks.detail: How much of the traffic was automated and filtered out (search crawlers, AI crawlers, monitors and the rest), so the human share is visible rather than implied.
